model_organism.citation: ATF2 and ATF7 Are Critical Mediators of Intestinal Epithelial Repair (PMID: 31958521)
phenotypes: No major phenotypic changes under homeostatic conditions
Impaired regenerative response after DSS exposure
Severe ulceration and inflammation with increased epithelial apoptosis on DSS exposure
Reduced ability to regenerate colonic crypts after whole-body irradiation
Organoids derived from double-mutant epithelium had growth disadvantage compared to wild-type
Impaired wound healing capacity in scratch assay
Increased sensitivity to TNF-alpha-induced damage in vitro

model_organism.citation: A role for ATF2 in regulating MITF and melanoma development (PMID: 21203491)
phenotypes: Transcriptionally inactive ATF2 in melanocytes strongly reduced melanoma development (1/21 mice developed melanoma vs 7/21 in controls)
Higher MITF expression in primary melanocytes expressing transcriptionally inactive ATF2
MITF downregulation confirmed in skin of Atf2-/- mice
ATF2 knockdown inhibited oncogenic BRAF(V600E)-dependent focus formation of melanocytes on soft agar

model_organism.citation: Effects of ATF2/TSC1 on epilepsy by modulating the microphages polarization of microglia (PMID: 40595935)
phenotypes: ATF2 knockdown diminished M1 polarization of KA-induced microglia
ATF2 knockdown enhanced M2 polarization
ATF2 knockdown relieved neuroinflammation in epilepsy mouse model
ATF2 expression increased in hippocampal tissues of KA-induced epilepsy mice
ATF2 negatively regulated TSC1 transcription by binding to its promoter

model_organism.citation: TRPC4 Mediates Trigeminal Neuropathic Pain via Ca(2+)-ERK/P38-ATF2 Pathway in the Trigeminal Ganglion of Mice (PMID: 40202077)
phenotypes: Trpc4 shRNA knockdown in trigeminal ganglion attenuated CION-induced pain behaviors
Downregulation of TRPC4 reduced ERK/P38 phosphorylation and ATF2 expression and activation
Reduced ATF2 activation associated with decreased neuropathic pain signaling

model_organism.citation: ATF2 loss promotes tumor invasion in colorectal cancer cells via upregulation of cancer driver TROP2 (PMID: 35838828)
phenotypes: ATF2 knockout triggered tumor invasiveness in in vivo mouse xenograft models
High TROP2 levels in ATF2 KO cells critical for cell de-adhesion and increased cell migration
ATF2KO/TROP2high status verified by in vivo imaging, micro-CT, and immunostainings

model_organism.citation: The Distant Molecular Effects on the Brain by Cancer Treatment (PMID: 38248237)
phenotypes: Atf2 upregulated in brains of doxorubicin-treated mice compared to controls
Gene expression changes associated with neuronal transmission and oxidative stress in doxorubicin-related cognitive impairment

model_organism.citation: ASHG 2010 - A53T-alpha-synuclein overexpression impairs dopamine signaling and striatal synaptic plasticity in old mice (S. Gispert Sanchez et al.)
phenotypes: Atf2 transcript levels progressively and genotype-dependently reduced in postsynaptic DA response in A53T-SNCA overexpressing mice
Dopamine levels correlated directly with SNCA expression level, also observed in SNCA-deficient (knockout) mice
Long term depression absent in corticostriatal slices from old transgenic mice

model_organism.citation: ASHG 2014 - Ttn as a likely causal gene for QTL of alcohol preference on mouse chromosome 2 (L. Wang et al.)
phenotypes: Atf2 evaluated as candidate gene for alcohol preference QTL on chromosome 2 but not confirmed for a definitive role in regulation of alcohol preference

biological.citation: ATF2 orchestrates macrophage differentiation and activation to promote antibacterial responses (PMID: 37403209)
biological.summary: ATF2 expression and activity are precisely regulated during human monocyte-to-macrophage differentiation, and its activation is linked to M1 polarization and antibacterial responses. Genetic deletion of ATF2 in THP-1 cells caused abnormal macrophage morphology, while overexpression produced round M1-like morphology with increased MHC-II, IL-1β, and IP-10 production, enhanced phagocytosis, and improved control of intracellular Mycobacterium tuberculosis. ATF2 overexpression or stimuli-induced activation also reprogrammed macrophage metabolism toward glycolysis during M1 polarization or bacterial infection.

biological.citation: Increased ATF2 expression predicts poor prognosis and inhibits sorafenib-induced ferroptosis in gastric cancer (PMID: 36473315)
biological.summary: ATF2 is significantly upregulated in gastric cancer tissues and predicts poor clinical prognosis. ATF2 knockdown promoted sorafenib-induced ferroptosis in gastric cancer cells, while overexpression inhibited it; ChIP-Seq and RNA-Seq identified HSPH1 as a direct ATF2 transcriptional target that stabilizes SLC7A11 protein to suppress ferroptosis. In vivo xenograft experiments confirmed that ATF2 knockdown enhances sorafenib sensitivity.

biological.citation: MG53 protects against septic cardiac dysfunction by ubiquitinating ATF2 (PMID: 40107350)
biological.summary: MG53 physically interacts with ATF2 and promotes its ubiquitination, leading to reduced ATF2-mediated transcriptional activation of TLR4 in cardiomyocytes. In a mouse LPS-induced septic cardiac dysfunction model, MG53 overexpression or exogenous administration reduced TLR4 expression, cardiomyocyte apoptosis, and inflammatory cytokine levels. This identifies ATF2 as an essential transcription factor for TLR4 expression in the heart.

biological.citation: Identification of a lipid oxygen radical defense pathway and its epigenetic control (PMID: 41372219)
biological.summary: ATF2 is a component of a repressive epigenetic complex (with ZNF354A, KAP1/TRIM28, and SETDB1) that silences the Lipid Oxygen Radical Defense (LORD) pathway under basal conditions. Upon lipid peroxide accumulation, p38- and JNK-dependent phosphorylation of ATF2 leads to disassembly of this complex and activation of protective genes including NRF2 targets. This positions ATF2 as a key sensor-effector in the cellular response to oxidative stress and ferroptosis.

biological.citation: TRAF6-p38/JNK-ATF2 axis promotes microglial inflammatory activation (PMID: 30763583)
biological.summary: In LPS-induced neuroinflammation, ATF2 is upregulated, phosphorylated, and translocates to the nucleus in microglia, co-localizing with microglia in inflamed mouse brain. Inhibiting ATF2 decreased pro-inflammatory factor expression in LPS-treated BV2 microglia and reduced neuronal apoptosis caused by conditioned medium from activated microglia. TRAF6 knockdown suppressed LPS-induced ATF2 expression and phosphorylation via reduced p38/JNK signaling, establishing the TRAF6-p38/JNK-ATF2 axis as a pro-inflammatory pathway in the CNS.

biological.citation: OGT-Mediated O-GlcNAcylation of ATF2 Protects Against Sepsis-Associated Encephalopathy by Inhibiting Microglial Pyroptosis (PMID: 40411666)
biological.summary: OGT-mediated O-GlcNAcylation of ATF2 at Ser44 inhibits ATF2 phosphorylation and nuclear translocation, thereby suppressing NLRP3 inflammasome activation and inflammatory cytokine production in microglia. OGT deficiency augmented microglial pyroptosis and worsened sepsis-associated encephalopathy in mice, while OGT inhibition impaired cognitive function. This reveals a post-translational modification of ATF2 that modulates its activity and downstream neuroinflammatory signaling.

biological.citation: Stimulus-Dependent Expression of Bdnf Is Mediated by ATF2, MYT1L, and EGR1 Transcription Factors (PMID: 39947922)
biological.summary: ATF2 directly binds to Bdnf promoters in cultured rat neurons and in vivo, as demonstrated by chromatin immunoprecipitation assays, and functionally regulates Bdnf gene expression. ATF2 participates in Bdnf regulation specifically after BDNF-TrkB signaling (as part of the AP1 family response), and competes with CREB and other AP1 family members at Bdnf promoter cis-elements. This identifies ATF2 as a novel regulator of stimulus-dependent Bdnf transcription in neurons.

biological.citation: MAP4K4 and WT1 mediate SOX6-induced cellular senescence by synergistically activating the ATF2-TGFβ2-Smad2/3 signaling pathway in cervical cancer (PMID: 38383842)
biological.summary: ATF2 acts as a downstream transcriptional effector of both the MAP4K4-MAPK (JNK/ERK/p38) and WT1 pathways to promote TGFB2 gene expression, which in turn activates the TGFβ2-Smad2/3-p53-p21-Rb senescence pathway in cervical cancer cells. SOX6-induced cellular senescence in cervical cancer is dependent on this MAP4K4/WT1-ATF2-TGFβ2 axis. Senescent cells induced through this pathway are resistant to cisplatin but sensitive to senolytics ABT-263 and ABT-199.

biological.citation: SIRT6 Lysine-Demyristoylates ATF2 to Ameliorate Vascular Injury via PRKCD/VE-Cadherin Pathway Regulating Vascular Endothelial Barrier (PMID: 40810740)
biological.summary: SIRT6 demyristoylates ATF2 at lysine K296, regulating its nucleoplasmic translocation; decreased nuclear ATF2 results in reduced PRKCD expression, establishing a SIRT6/Myr-ATF2/PRKCD/VE-Cadherin pathway that enhances endothelial barrier integrity. These findings were validated in gene overexpression/knockdown cell lines and in SIRT6 knockout/double-transgenic mice. This identifies lysine myristoylation as a novel post-translational modification controlling ATF2 localization and vascular function.

biological.citation: ATF2/BAP1 Axis Mediates Neuronal Apoptosis After Subarachnoid Hemorrhage via P53 Pathway (PMID: 38965653)
biological.summary: ATF2 regulates BAP1 expression by directly binding to the BAP1 promoter in neurons, as demonstrated by luciferase and co-immunoprecipitation assays in a subarachnoid hemorrhage model. BAP1 overexpression enhanced P53 activity and stability by reducing proteasome-mediated P53 degradation, promoting neuronal apoptosis. Inhibition of the neuronal BAP1/P53 axis significantly reduced neurological deficits and neuronal apoptosis in mice after SAH, identifying ATF2 as an upstream transcriptional regulator of this pro-apoptotic cascade.
